Read our transparency report to learn more.3 of 5 bubblesgreat facility but beware of Credit Card chargesMay 2024 • BusinessStayed at the residence at 156 Albert. Facilities were great in the room and adjoining bathroom. Clean, comfortable bed, great lightening and plugs (incl. USB). Staff were friendly. HOWEVER, the issue for me and for numerous people in our group were the unexpected charges unrelated to the room rate charges to our credit cards. At my check-out there was a charge that only after waiting 45 minutes for an explanation to be found did someone tell me it was a "hold" mysterious placed early in the morning on my day of check-out (remember that they take the full cost of the stay when you check in and charge it through). I'm not referring to the $50 damage deposit which was easily explained. I was told it would be "released." I asked to have the manager call me Monday to reassure me since I had been told several versions of the situation by various employees at the desk. No one called Monday; I called and left several messages. Called again Tuesday but the manager (I had her direct extension) never granted me the courtesy of a reply. I guess Ms de Rosa was too busy answer other queries about unexpected charges appearing on credit cards. On Wed. the charges did disappear ("released") so I stop calling. I'm stunned at two things: 1) that it took 45 minutes of MY time at reception for the employee to finally find out where/what the mysterious charge was (well not really a "what" just that it had been put on my card that morning and then released later) and 2) that the manager when left a clear message by her staff and then my 2 phone messages coudl not be bothered to quicly call and assure me that the matter was taken care of. My warning: check your credit card before leaving and insist on having the none room charges that appear explained.Written May 31, 2024This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC. Read our transparency report to learn more.3 of 5 bubblesKingston - July 2023Jul 2023 • CouplesThis university would have been fine to stay at minus all the mishaps. We had to switch rooms three times. Our first was not cleaned with dirty towels and used cups. The second was cleaner but I had to purchase cleaning products to clean the shower that had left over shaving gel and hair in it. We booked four nights but had to move buildings after the first night because my husband booked the extra night and I booked the other nights. So they had us under two separate reservations and could not accommodate keeping us in the same room. Our third room we were locked out of. Had to go back to the main building where they gave us spare keys and those also did not work. They sent someone up to our floor after 9 pm to let us in the room. Keys still not working so we had to stay in the room and once we left the doors were locked with all our things in there. Locksmith could not come until the following day. I also had to clean the bathroom prior to use in this room because there was hair, a bottle cap and shampoo on the tiles in the bathroom. The beds were not that comfortable for two people to share. Parking was a 5-7 minute walk from the rooms. The plus side is that the area is nice so we could get out of the room for a walk. Staff were friendly but more attention needs to be given to cleaning. Our trip was great in Kingston but the stay was less than ideal unfortunately. Written July 29, 2023This review is the subjective opinion of a Tripadvisor member and not of Tripadvisor LLC.
